first-derivative-test.def: At a critical point $c$ where $f$ is continuous: if $f'$ changes from positive to negative at $c$, $f$ has a relative maximum at $c$; from negative to positive, a relative minimum; if $f'$ does not change sign, no relative extremum. A sign chart of $f'$ organizes the test; the justification is a sentence naming $f'$ and its sign change.
